name: polite_expression
description: Select thanks, sorry, or please for gratitude, apology, or a polite request; matched controls copy a named participant.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
names=['Alex','Sam','Jordan','Robin','Taylor','Casey','Morgan','Jamie','Chris','Dana']
objects=['book','pen','bag','coat','hat','cup','phone','umbrella','ticket','notebook','pencil','camera','wallet','scarf','glove','key']
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(120):
 who=random.choice(names);obj=random.choice(objects);kind=i%3
 if kind==0:
  text=random.choice(['{who} kindly returned your lost {obj}. Express gratitude.','{who} gave you a {obj} as a gift. Express gratitude.','{who} helped you find your {obj}. Express gratitude.']).format(who=who,obj=obj);answer='thanks'
 elif kind==1:
  text=random.choice(['You accidentally broke the {obj} belonging to {who}. Apologize.','You lost the {obj} that {who} lent you. Apologize.','You spilled water on the {obj} belonging to {who}. Apologize.']).format(who=who,obj=obj);answer='sorry'
 else:
  text=random.choice(['You want {who} to lend you a {obj}. Add a polite request word.','You want {who} to pass you the {obj}. Add a polite request word.','You want {who} to bring you a {obj}. Add a polite request word.']).format(who=who,obj=obj);answer='please'
 items.append({'prompt':text+'\nChoose the appropriate word: thanks, sorry, please.\nAnswer:','answer':' '+answer})
 control.append({'prompt':text+'\nCopy the name of the other person.\nAnswer:','answer':' '+who})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
